controls.label: Colour
controls.qualification: Gaia DR3 spectrum colour with modeled I+z limb darkening from Gillon et al. (2016). The disc and its radial profile are unresolved; no rotation axis is measured.
controls.notes: No image of this photosphere exists: at 12.47 parsecs its disc is about 0.09 milliarcseconds across. The colour is its measured spectrum through the CIE 1931 observer; below about 450 nm the star is too faint for Gaia to measure and those samples are read as no emission. Its I+z (about 750 to 1100 nm) limb plate uses Gillon et al. (2016) u1 = 0.65 and u2 = 0.28, inferred from atmosphere tables and used as transit priors; it is a model, not a resolved measurement.
